description: Cloud platform for frontend frameworks and static sites, providing fast deployments, serverless functions, and infrastructure.
auth_notes: Vercel API requests are authenticated using Vercel Access Tokens passed in the Authorization header as a Bearer token.
credential_notes: Developers can sign up for a free Hobby account and create Personal Access Tokens directly in their account settings at no cost.
api_notes: Comprehensive REST API covering deployments, domains, projects, environment variables, storage, logs, and more.
mcp_notes: Official Model Context Protocol server published by Vercel on GitHub (vercel/mcp-server-vercel).
rationale: Vercel provides a fully documented REST API, free self-serve account creation with access tokens, and an official MCP server, making it instantly buildable as an AI agent toolkit.

evidence.note: Documents the REST API and Bearer token authentication mechanism using Vercel Access Tokens.
Shows the free Hobby tier allowing users to sign up and access platform features.
Lists extensive endpoints across deployments, projects, domains, environment, etc.
